spans.s: Ūrva, a ṛshi. § 745c (Cyavana-Kuśikasaṃv.): XIII, 56, 2907 (father of Ṛcīka, cast the fire of his anger into the mouth of the mare's head (vaḍavāvaktre)). Cf. Aurva.
